name: Performance Focus
body:
Prerequisite(s): Bardic performance class feature

Benefit(s): Select a single bardic performance you know. Add +2 to the saving throw DC of the selected performance.

Special: This feat can be selected multiple times. Its effects do not stack. Each time you select the feat, it applies to a new bardic performance.
